== Summary ==
Slip “•Jabiim: Path Operations Center” cut unchanged from page 3 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata] (PDF file created 26 December 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (68, 1543, 755, 2091)). Version [[Jabiim: Path Operations Center|Jabiim: Path Operations Center (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Not a recreation.
